caption: a woman is applying makeup to her face
reference: This video showcases a woman meticulously perfecting her eyebrows using an eyebrow pencil. The individual has long, flowing hair that is a striking mix of black and brown, framing her face on both sides. Her makeup is nearly complete, featuring bold black eyeshadow, black eyeliner adorned with silver glitter at the inner corners, and she has applied false eyelashes. On her right hand, she wears a large ring that combines yellow and white hues, and in front of her, there is a makeup mirror. The background of the video is decorated with vertical stripes in blue and pink, and in the upper right corner, there's a white watermark that reads "koii koii." As she works on her eyebrows, the woman holds a brown eyebrow pencil in her right hand, which has a silver design on the barrel. She starts by dabbing the pencil several times at the front of her left eyebrow, then gently taps it on the front of her right eyebrow. Following this, she glances at the mirror to assess her look before horizontally applying a few strokes above her left eyebrow. The video is filmed from her perspective, and it's clear that her eyebrows appear excessively thick, indicating that her eyebrow application technique could use some refinement.

caption: a woman demonstrates how to apply eyebrow makeup
reference: This video showcases a woman as she meticulously draws her eyebrows using an eyebrow pencil and a small brush. Her hair is a striking blend of black and yellow, styled up. Throughout the video, only the right side of her eyebrow and eye are visible. In the upper left corner of the video, there's a semi-transparent watermark; the first line reads "Meipai," while the second line displays "ID: 1520200135." At the lower right corner, a rectangular label with a black background and white text states: "iol@makeup-fashion." The woman is wearing light blue contact lenses that enhance her gaze. The video is sped up, and during the eyebrow sculpting process, she first picks up the black eyebrow pencil. She carefully draws a line beneath her eyebrow, then angles another line at the tail end above it, connecting it to the previously drawn slant. Following that, she grabs a small black eyebrow brush to blend and soften the lines she had just created, giving shape to her brows. The entire video is shot from her perspective, highlighting her straight eyebrows and skilled technique.

caption: a woman in a red shirt is applying makeup to her face
reference: This video showcases a person demonstrating how to select an eyebrow brush and eyebrow powder. The woman featured has her black hair tied up and is wearing two gray Velcro strips on her head. Her face is fully made up, except for her eyebrows; she sports a bright red lipstick and wears a pair of black and yellow earrings. On her upper body, she is dressed in a short-sleeved top with a vibrant red base adorned with a green sequined pattern on the front. On her left hand, she has a gold ring on her ring finger.During the demonstration, she holds a brown eyebrow brush in her right hand, which has a black upper half and a yellow lower half. She shows the brush in the palm of her left hand, facing outward. Next, she reaches for an eyebrow powder palette from below, revealing a lighter brown powder on the left side and a darker brown on the right. She covers the left side of the palette and continues her explanation, then puts the palette down and shakes her head a few times while also gently shaking the brush she’s holding. After dipping the brush into the eyebrow powder, she applies it to the front of her right eyebrow, while holding a small pink mirror in her left hand, ready to start shaping her eyebrows. The entire video is filmed from her perspective, making her clear and concise explanations easy to understand.

caption: a woman is demonstrating how to apply eyebrow makeup
reference: This video features a self-introduction by a content creator. In the upper left corner, there is a combination of text and graphics; the top line showcases the pink caption "chiutips," while the middle section presents the phrase "TIPS, TRICKS & HACKS FOR THE EVERYDAY GIRL" on a blue background with white lettering. To the right of this frame, blue text reads "Eyebrow tutorial for beginners!" Below that, there are three circular icons, all featuring a white design on a blue background. The lower right corner of the black frame has a purple doodle arrow pointing towards a red square with white text saying "click here to subscribe." On the right side of the video, there is a photo of the creator with half of her face visible, wearing pink lipstick and a black top. caption: a woman demonstrates how to apply eyeliner
reference: This video showcases the process of an adult woman applying eyeliner. It begins with a close-up of her eyes, brows, and a distinctive gold nose ring. You can see her hand holding a black eyeliner pencil, while the other hand gently rests near her temple, close to the outer corner of her eye. She proceeds to apply the eyeliner, starting from the inner corner and smoothly extending along the base of her upper lashes toward the outer corner, all while keeping her eyes closed. At the bottom of the screen, there’s a piece of text in bold, uppercase letters summarizing key tips, which appears twice during the video. As the camera zooms in, it focuses on her right eye. At this moment, the same tip summary appears at a similar spot, specifically highlighting the eyeliner at the outer corner of her eye. The shot then transitions to a full view of her face, revealing her wearing pink lipstick. Her left eye is closed while her right eye is slightly open as she mirrors the eyeliner application on her left eye just as she did on the right. Finally, another tip summary appears at the bottom of the video. At this stage, the woman adds some finishing touches to the eyeliner at the outer corner of her eye. The video is filmed from a slightly elevated front angle, providing excellent clarity and showcasing numerous intricate details.
